Story_Short: Confidence indicator on product page (core AI)
Rationale_Top5: Prerequisite for all other stories; RICE is depressed by high effort (13pw) but this is the only story that unblocks the entire backlog — must be scheduled first regardless of raw rank
Confidence_Evidence_Gap: Calibration: can the model hit High≥85% accuracy? Evidence gap: no A/B data yet. Confidence would rise to 100% after a 4-week pilot in 1–2 stores.

Story_Short: Fallback to binary status when unavailable
Rationale_Top5: Ships as part of S1 delivery package — defines the degraded-state behaviour required for S1 to be shippable at all; if fallback is wrong (shows stale In Stock), the feature causes more harm than the problem it solves
Confidence_Evidence_Gap: n/a — requirement is certain; 100% confidence is correct

Story_Short: Warning modal before reserving at Low
Rationale_Top5: Ships with S1; prevents the core failure mode — shopper drives to store for nothing — for sessions that see Low confidence; safety requirement; WCAG accessibility baked in per patched AC
Confidence_Evidence_Gap: 80% confidence: modal behaviour is well-understood; remaining 20% is uncertainty on how many sessions will see Low confidence (depends on model calibration)

Confidence_Evidence_Gap: Evidence gap: what fraction of Low sessions have a better-confidence alternative within 30km? Upgrade to 80% after 4 weeks of S1 calibration data.

Story_Short: Velocity signal — same-day POS in model
Rationale_Top5: Model-layer enhancement included in S1 delivery scope; Confidence=50% because predictive power of same-day POS velocity at store-SKU level is unproven before offline experimentation on historical POS data
Confidence_Evidence_Gap: Evidence gap: does same-day sell-through rate improve model MAPE by ≥5% on held-out test? Run offline experiment on 6 months of POS history before including in S1 model. Upgrade to 80% if offline lift is confirmed.
